$comment: Example integrity manifest verified by `tools-offline-app-dev.py verify --manifest <this-file> --root <bundle-dir>`. Replace the example entry with your own files (generate one manifest for a directory with `verify --init-manifest <this-file> --root <bundle-dir>`). Paths are relative to --root; sha256 is lowercase hex. Files listed but missing, or whose hash differs, fail verification. Files in the root that are NOT listed are reported as untracked (warning, not failure, unless --strict is given).

files.role: example-only: sha256 of an empty file; replace with your real bundle entries
